Data-safety and Sharia research-only separation.
First-seen, persistence and gain-retention instrumentation.
Stricter Sharia presentation and research-only gating.
Runtime identity and audit cleanup.
Runtime consolidation and reduced overlay dependency.
Stable /tag500/ entrypoint.
20-minute Freshness Gate, VERIFIED-only executive ranking and reconciliation training gate.
Persistence Slope, Gain Retention and Late-RVOL Guard.
Temporal trajectory promoted into decision UI.
Live-data routing fixed to main-first with explicit data-origin audit.
Central Signal-Origin Gate blocks late Discovery credit.
Origin Confirmation combines first-seen with persistence/retention.
Actionability-first ranking A/B/C/Late.
Catalyst Clock and post-signal attribution guard.
Full catalyst timeline preserves valid pre-signal catalysts.
Visibility-aware auto-refresh and overlapping-request protection.
Refresh Health Gate tracks usable refresh outcomes.
Executive-first UX with separate Research Mode.
Session-aware final after-hours close handling.
Runtime consistency and final-close layer activation.
Runtime identity authority and visible blocker explanations.
Catalyst-relevance intent recorded; later audit found runtime mismatch.
Catalyst Relevance and Source Quality Gate.
Catalyst-to-Score Integrity Gate.
Catalyst schema-integrity fix.
Active score-field integration fix.
Runtime consistency guard removes obsolete dynamic catalyst injection.
Runtime Health alias and non-destructive blocking fix.
Actionability runtime contract exported explicitly.
Refresh outcome integrity and runtime identity fix.
Same-session final-close integrity at the 8:00 PM ET boundary.
Final-Close Lock protects a same-session final AH candidate from later refresh degradation.
Release Identity Authority and runtime-ready health recheck.
Session Alignment Gate: freshness now also requires the source snapshot to match the active market session; transition snapshots fail closed until the new session feed arrives. No threshold retune.

Enrichment Freshness Gate: Catalyst/No-News credit is blocked when enrichment lags the market snapshot by more than 20 minutes or lacks a valid timestamp; Catalyst Quality runtime contract exported for health checks. No threshold retune.

Central Persistence First: pipeline PM/RTH/AH persistence and gain retention now override browser-only LocalStorage when eligible; retention is normalized to 0–100% when new highs make raw ratios exceed 100%. No threshold retune.

Universe Early-Warning Audit: current top-20 movers are audited by first-observed change to expose early-universe coverage versus late-origin debt. Intraperiod/observational only; no threshold retune or training claim before reconciliation.

Universe Composition Gate: conservative early-origin coverage uses the full top-20 denominator, unknown origins count against coverage, and reactive-only discovery sources are flagged so in-universe capture is not mistaken for market-wide early discovery. No threshold retune.

Temporal Continuity Gate: LocalStorage fallback cannot confirm persistence or EARLY_CONFIRMED when pipeline cadence has GAP_ERROR, persistence is ineligible, or fields are frozen; local observations remain research-only. No threshold retune.

Persistence Authority Gate: fixes the TAG539 integration path and makes eligible central pipeline persistence the only source allowed to confirm EARLY_CONFIRMED; LocalStorage temporal history is research-only. No threshold retune.

Core Runtime Pinning: TAG500 now owns pinned copies of its app runtime, data-integrity layer, and base stylesheet instead of executing those critical files from the shared tag project. Shared market data remains the only intentional cross-project dependency. No threshold retune.

UI Dependency Pinning: TAG500 now owns pinned dashboard/webapp/concise styles too, eliminating silent visual/UX drift from shared tag CSS. Shared market data remains the only intentional cross-project dependency. No threshold retune.

Decision Trace: a unified top-candidate evidence ledger shows why-now signals and execution/training blockers across origin, persistence, catalyst, Sharia and data integrity. No threshold retune or training claim.
